summary: Iter87 FRONTEND-ONLY QA of restored iters 91-93 (Photo Verification, AI Best Nearby Match on Radar, Benefits of Human Connection row, removal of Orrbbit Worldwide section) with Today dashboard unchanged. All 8 requested items pass. Mobile viewport 390x844, Playwright with JSON-stringified localStorage.auth_token per playbook. (1) /login → 'Explore Demo' logs in as demo@intro.demo (Alex) and lands on Today dashboard (today-greeting visible, live stats 9 events / 57 people / 500m radius). Bottom nav = Today | Radar | Nearby | Encounters | Profile — tab-pings NOT present. today-bell button present (testID today-bell); today-bell-badge only renders when unread>0, so absence is correct-by-design and the bell button routes to /notifications. (2) Radar tab (People) renders best-match-card kicker 'AI BEST NEARBY MATCH' with ai-match-note testID and 'Why shown:' line. Demo ping popup was dismissed via 'Dismiss' text. (3) Profile tab: Orrbbit Worldwide section GONE — 0 hits for any of {City Launch Mode, Event Mode, Join Event Code, Orrbbit Campus, Orrbbit Networking, Communities, Ambassador Hub, Join Waitlist, Orrbbit Worldwide}. menu-photo-verification row present, menu-benefits row 'Benefits of Human Connection' present (route https://orrbbit.com/benefits-of-human-connection per code), my-photo-verified-badge orange tick beside 'Alex, 29' and menu-photo-verified-tick beside the Photo Verification row (both because demo alex is photo_verified). (4) /photo-verification as alex renders pv-verified-state 'You’re Photo Verified' card with orange badge. /photo-verification as an unverified demo user renders pv-rules, pv-start ('Take live selfie'), intro copy 'Take a fresh selfie...', footnote 'not identity or government ID verification'. Camera permission not forced (headless web) — pre-permission start state confirmed as pass per instructions. (5) Nearby list (Kauri POV, radius=500m at Melbourne CBD) exposes 5 photo-verified-<id> testIDs including Jake (id=33b9338e-...). /person/{jake_id} renders photo-verified-badge (orange tick) beside 'Jake, 29'. (6) /profile-setup as an unverified user with seeded photos renders setup-photo-verification card. (7) Control Centre user detail cc-photo-verification wiring verified at API level (GET /api/control/users/{jake_id} with QA admin token returns photo_verification={status:'verified', photo_verified:true, confidence:96, model:'gpt-5', checked_at:...}). Per iter86 note, /control UI is not exercised in Playwright to avoid production origin override; the /app/frontend/app/control/user/[id].tsx code binds cc-photo-verification directly to data.photo_verification. (8) Regression smoke: Radar tabs (People/Professional) + vibe pill + Visible chip + Nearby people list + Profile logout button + bell button all render with no red-screen errors. NOTE for main agent: task expected sophie@intro.demo to be photo_verified=false, but the current seed actually returns photo_verified=true / status=verified for sophie (probably an earlier POST verification or seed drift). Used sarah@intro.demo (photo_verification_status=none) as the not-verified subject for step 4 — behaviour is identical. Non-blocking web-only warnings 'shadow* props deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' still emitted (carried from iter86, cosmetic).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Playwright pattern for auth: fetch /api/auth/demo-login {email}, then localStorage.setItem('auth_token', JSON.stringify(access_token)) BEFORE navigating to protected routes — AuthProvider reads that key on mount via storage.secureGet (web AsyncStorage). Nearby endpoint requires ?lat=&lng=&radius= query params and returns {count, users:[...]} (not a bare array). /control UI is not to be exercised in Playwright (production origin override); verify Control Centre features via /api/control/* HTTP calls instead. Demo ping popup shows ~4s after Radar mount — dismiss via page.get_by_text('Dismiss').click(force=True). sophie@intro.demo is currently PHOTO-VERIFIED in seed (drift from docs) — use sarah/liam/emily@intro.demo when a status='none' persona is required.
